speaker: (a man)
text: Fifteen barges. Count them as they come. Fifteen, with streamers, up from Greenwich, and every gun at the Tower answering the music.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You have two eyes, friend, and so has the man behind you, who has seen nothing but your collar since the first trumpet. Tell it to the blind. The rest of us are busy looking round you.

speaker: (a man)
text: There. White smoke on the water. That was the ordnance. Tell me you saw the smoke.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I saw a haberdasher try the ditch, then a wheel, then a prayer, to get one inch past your shoulder. There is the comedy, Master Shakespeare. The river is only the excuse. You may have the prince. I will keep the haberdasher.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let him talk. Dick is the one who came to learn a disembarking, and I am the one who came to be proved a rogue at a discount.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Leave the streamers. Look at the lead boat. Cloth of silver, and the knee. A boat shifts under a man's heel. If he looks down at the wet plank, he is a student in a hired cloak. See. He kept his chin to the halberds.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Have you stolen it already, Augustine?

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The double tongue, and then the shawms. Give me a king's entrance in the spring and I will set that tucket behind the door, two trumpets, and no one will know it came off a river.

speaker: (a man)
text: He steps ashore. The Prince steps out, and the guns answer him as if the Tower had his name in a book.

speaker: will_kemp
text: And the haberdasher has put his neighbour in the kennel for joy of the ordnance. You may cheer the silver cloak. I am cheering the neighbour, who will have a laundress to face.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Watch the elbow, Will. He let the waterman take it, and he did not look round to see whether the hand was there. That is how a man in borrowed majesty gets out of a boat.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He trusts the plank to come up to the boot. I will keep the elbow. I will not give the student a name. He has not offered one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Look under the third barge, where the tide crowds a wherry. One oar is lifted almost upright, to let the gilt pass without a splash on the velvet.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: An oar at the salute, to spare another boat its dignity. The boy in the stern will never know the waterman did it.

speaker: (a man)
text: Now they mount. Trumpets before them, and they ride through the City. I have shown you the whole of it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You have shown us your collar and a procession we could see when you breathed in. Dick. Have you majesty enough now to play at two, or shall we wait for the barges to row home and improve you?

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Enough to keep my chin up when a bucket goes over. Let them ride. We have a dinner and a play, and this wind is not a friend.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Keep that tucket out of my mouth until there is paper at the Keys. If I hum it through Egeon's first scene I will never forgive the river, and the river will not care.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A moment. The smoke is still on the flood. I want the oar, not the speech the man is making of it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Be brief. Thou art due at two, not at the turn of their tide. Come off the slope.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Come, Augustine. He will stand here till Greenwich wants its barges back, and you will let him, because of a trumpet.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: I have the tucket, and I have his pointing in my sleeve. I do not need a third music. I am coming.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Go on. I am a breath behind. Errors at two, and I am in it. The first Caesar is the Rose today. I am not going across for a Roman.

speaker: (a man)
text: Fifteen. I said fifteen, and fifteen it was.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You said what was already in front of us. I have had the better half, which was the neighbours. We are quits, friend. Enjoy the mud.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou hast looked long enough, Will. The russet is mine, the boat is his, and the dinner is getting cold at a house that does not care for princes. Come.
